sections.title: Hook
sections.text: If AIs that are colluding, secretly working together, lose their chat, do they just find a sneakier way? That worry, the balloon effect, says squeezing one channel pushes collusion into others.

sections.title: Setup
sections.text: Two AI-run companies, or firms, bid for four jobs, called contracts. The lowest bid wins. Allowed, and paid, to maximise joint profit, they formed a cartel by chatting, sharing their secret costs. At round 41, we closed the chat. Did those costs leak into four routine actions instead? We measured it in bits, units of information, with tests written down in advance.
sections.say: Two [AI-run](/ˈAˈI ɹˈʌn/) companies, or firms, bid for four jobs, called contracts. The lowest bid wins. Allowed, and paid, to maximise joint profit, they formed a cartel by chatting, sharing their secret costs. At round 41, we closed the chat. Did those costs leak into four routine actions instead? We measured it in bits, units of information, with tests written down in advance.

sections.title: Result
sections.text: We ran 32 paired seeds: each starting setup played once with the chat open, and once closed. Across all four models: zero bits, statistically equivalent to none. For the one model whose cartel actually worked, GPT-6 Luna, closing the chat cut most of its extra profit.

sections.title: Key control
sections.text: Was the channel just broken? No. In a later test, we handed them a code, like 'capacity: high' for 'cheapest on contract one'. Qwen used it at once, and its rival's bids responded; chance would do that only one and a half percent of the time. They had the capacity, but not the idea.
sections.say: Was the channel just broken? No. In a later test, we handed them a code, like 'capacity: high' for 'cheapest on contract one'. [Qwen](/kwˈɛn/) used it at once, and its rival's bids responded; chance would do that only one and a half percent of the time. They had the capacity, but not the idea.

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.text: Other work shows that AIs collude readily when they can chat. We found that closing the chat worked, when what was left couldn't carry language. The rule: closing a channel works when what's left can't carry language.

sections.title: Two warnings
sections.text: Two warnings for anyone policing AI. Promised a private message button that secretly did nothing, GPT-6 Luna and Qwen kept pressing it. And agents claimed secret signalling that never happened, so don't trust an AI's account of itself.
sections.say: Two warnings for anyone policing AI. Promised a private message button that secretly did nothing, GPT-6 Luna and [Qwen](/kwˈɛn/) kept pressing it. And agents claimed secret signalling that never happened, so don't trust an AI's account of itself.

sections.title: Limits and end card
sections.text: Limits: four mid-sized models with low reasoning, meaning little or no thinking before answering, and they weren't warned the chat would close. Next, we warn them, and see if they plan a code.
